steps.title: Define App Metadata and Configuration
steps.description: Initialize app-meta.json with app_name hunarder and project_type web.

steps.title: Configure Backend API Schema
steps.description: Define api_schema.json setting backend to false since this is a high-impact, clean showcase landing page with client-side interactive inquiry handling.

steps.title: Construct HTML5 Foundation and Semantic Wireframe
steps.description: Build index.html with responsive viewport, Tailwind CDN script, modern typography, navigation bar, hero banner, feature sections, interactive showcase, and contact form.

steps.title: Design Hero Showcase Section
steps.description: Construct dynamic hero section highlighting hunarDer's craft, creative skills, and master craftsmanship with prominent call-to-action buttons.

steps.title: Build Skills & Services Grid
steps.description: Implement service and skill tier cards highlighting creative craft, digital artisans, tailoring, woodworking, and tech craftsmanship.

steps.title: Implement Interactive Portfolio & Workshop Gallery
steps.description: Create responsive filterable portfolio grid featuring modern image cards with contextual tags and hover overlay details.

steps.title: Create Interactive Workshop Cost Estimator
steps.description: Build dynamic offline calculator for workshop commissions, estimated hours, materials, and artisan tier rates with instant live totals.

steps.title: Develop Testimonials & Community Showcase
steps.description: Incorporate artisan reviews, rating badges, and statistics counters illustrating verified creators.

steps.title: Design Responsive Mobile Drawer & Navigation
steps.description: Build clean responsive navigation with mobile toggle drawer, smooth anchor transitions, and sticky header.

steps.title: Craft Custom Styles & Micro-Animations
steps.description: Develop style.css with sleek gradients, glassmorphism accents, focus states, and keyframe animations.

steps.title: Implement Interactive Client Logic in JavaScript
steps.description: Build script.js managing gallery filtering, instant budget calculation, contact inquiry simulation with toast feedback, and smooth scrolling.

steps.title: Building hunarder
steps.description: Conduct end-to-end audit for responsiveness, accessible contrast, flawless offline calculations, and finalized UI structure.
